cross_system_observations.proposition: Project Runner, WIP and DriftGuard expose complementary but non-identical state machines.
support: Project Runner centers authorized orchestration, exact mutable preconditions and completion verification.
WIP centers work-state recovery and ambiguous-effect reconciliation.
DriftGuard centers behavioral drift evidence and separates reload decisions, effects and later behavioral qualification.

cross_system_observations.proposition: A neutral effect envelope can interoperate across Project Runner, WIP and DriftGuard without replacing their native state semantics.
support: Discovery experiments bind all three public producers to one unchanged experimental envelope.
Producer-native state interpretation remains outside the neutral observer.

cross_system_observations.proposition: The existing effect-envelope line did not demonstrate net maintenance reduction sufficient to justify centralization.
support: Discovery PR #13 recorded zero pre-existing source-specific parser lines deleted.
Discovery PR #14 found no valid organic parser replacement target and set STOP_EFFECT_ENVELOPE_CENTRALIZATION_PENDING_ORGANIC_REPLACEMENT_TARGET.

cross_system_observations.proposition: Portfolio completeness and architecture authority are different claims.
support: Discovery currently observes 58 repositories, including 35 private repositories that remain opaque in this public repository.
Discovery candidate states explicitly do not grant merge, deployment, installation or semantic authority elsewhere.

architecture_hypothesis.proposition: Portfolio cohesion should be implemented as federated interoperability between independently authoritative systems, with shared contracts promoted only when real consumers prove simplification.
share_first: neutral transport/interchange envelopes where producer-native semantics remain authoritative

private_portfolio_boundary.note: This packet intentionally does not publish private repository identities or private mechanism details.

objections.challenge: A layered architecture diagram can become architecture theater unless it predicts concrete deletions, failure isolation or reduced operational burden.
objections.required_falsifier: Demonstrate one organic cross-project integration where the federated contract measurably removes duplicated glue or prevents a failure class without creating a mandatory central dependency.

objections.challenge: Existing boundaries can be cited circularly to justify federation even when a stronger shared abstraction might be better.
objections.required_falsifier: Permit a candidate shared mechanism to win if two independent consumers show lower total complexity, preserved rollback and no authority collapse.
Use approved opaque/private attestation mechanisms before claiming the hypothesis generalizes across the private cohort.

next_experiments.question: Can one organic cross-project handoff use exact provenance, authority and effect evidence without any participant adopting another participant's native state machine?
next_experiments.success: At least two independent consumers use the contract and measurable duplicated glue or reconciliation work is removed.
next_experiments.failure: Adapters add equal or greater maintenance burden, authority semantics blur, or any consumer becomes dependent on a central runtime for basic local operation.

next_experiments.question: Can a shared currentness receipt distinguish source, package, install, route, runtime consumption, effect and qualification without promoting one repository into global authority?
next_experiments.success: Two independent projects validate the same receipt shape while retaining project-owned currentness decisions.
next_experiments.failure: The shared receipt requires project-specific semantics or becomes a de facto global truth store.
